title: Born Flawless

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered ethereal gown with a fitted corset bodice, a flowing A-line skirt with cascading tulle tiers, and asymmetrical crystalline shoulder draping.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: An intricate silver filigree tiara with a central star motif, paired with translucent ice-like wing-shaped hair accessories and floating crystal ornaments.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A strapless sweetheart bodice encrusted with silver beadwork and sequins, featuring a sheer organza overlay and delicate detached arm drapes of iridescent tulle.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A voluminous layered skirt with pleated underlayers and a high-low hemline revealing diaphanous fabric, completed with sparkling crystal-embellished heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Translucent butterfly wing structures framing the head, floating diamond-shaped crystals, and trailing ribbons of starlight and frost.
